tie_market_rule: three markets an event; the Tie market is the one whose ticker ends in -TIE. For the cell NHL_REG the market is the single market of the event (ticker ends in -1) and YES means the game was level after regulation.
start_rule: scheduled start = occurrence_datetime of the market minus 180 minutes

cells.period: quarters 1 to 4, pooled, base rate per quarter
first half, pooled, base rate per series

not_in_this_card: college football quarters (base rate near 15%, so a 10c gap would be a cheap-tail contract), NBA and college basketball quarters and halves (Tie under 10%), NFL halves (Tie under 10%), second halves in soccer (one known series)
